content.text: Planning the aqueduct, and checking arch part dimensions first.
Arches are 1 brick tall. Building tier 1: dark-tan footings, five piers, four 1×6 arches, 4 studs deep.
Deck band, then second tier: seven short piers and six 1×4 arches.
Top deck, channel side walls with dark-tan coping, and trans-blue water.
Adding dark-tan abutment buttresses at both ends, on the outer footing strips.
